criteria: signal-forge.html is one self-contained Web Audio modular synth and 16-step sequencer (no libraries, no audio samples): multiple oscillators (sine/square/triangle/saw/noise), ADSR envelopes, filters, an LFO, delay/distortion/reverb and polyphony; an 8-track step sequencer with per-step controls, tempo and swing; a piano keyboard; live oscilloscope and spectrum visualizers on canvas; presets and save/load. Audio starts only after a user gesture and avoids clicks.

review.description: Web Audio modular synth + 16-step sequencer: oscillators/ADSR/filters/FX, 8 tracks, keyboard, oscilloscope + spectrum, presets, save/load. Audio on user gesture. Stress case.
